例句

  1. There are four people in my family. Our apartment is on the fifth floor of this building.
    我家有四個人。我們的公寓在這棟大樓的五樓。
  2. There are two parks near my house.
    我家附近有兩座公園。
  3. There is a bookstore near the station.
    車站附近有一家書店。
  4. There is some milk in the fridge.
    冰箱裡有一些牛奶。
  5. There are thirty students in our class.
    我們班上有三十個學生。
  6. There was a big earthquake in Kobe in 1995.
    1995 年神戶發生了大地震。
  7. Is there a bank near here?
    這附近有銀行嗎？
  8. There aren't any buses after ten.
    十點以後沒有公車。
  9. There are many temples in Kyoto.
    京都有很多寺廟。
  10. There is a cat under the table.
    桌子底下有一隻貓。
  11. My classroom is on the third floor.
    我的教室在三樓。
  12. The bookstore is on the second floor of the department store.
    書店在百貨公司的二樓。
  13. We live on the tenth floor.
    我們住在十樓。
  14. The toilets are on the first floor.
    廁所在一樓。
  15. My uncle's office is on the twentieth floor of that building.
    我叔叔的辦公室在那棟大樓的二十樓。
  16. Take the elevator to the sixth floor.
    搭電梯到六樓。
  17. There is a café on the fourth floor of this building.
    這棟大樓的四樓有一間咖啡店。
  18. There are three bedrooms in our apartment.
    我們的公寓有三間臥室。
  19. There are six people in Ken's family, so their house is always noisy.
    Ken 家有六個人，所以他們家總是很吵。
  20. How many people are there in your family?
    你家有幾個人？
  21. There were only two people in my family before my sister was born.
    我妹妹出生之前，我家只有兩個人。
  22. Our apartment is on the second floor, so we don't use the elevator.
    我們的公寓在二樓，所以我們不搭電梯。
  23. The library is on the fifth floor of the school building.
    圖書館在學校大樓的五樓。
  24. There is a convenience store on the first floor of my apartment building.
    我住的公寓大樓一樓有一家便利商店。
  25. There isn't any water in the bottle.
    瓶子裡沒有水。
  26. My grandparents live on the seventh floor of an old building.
    我爺爺奶奶住在一棟老大樓的七樓。
  27. There are a lot of people at the station on Monday mornings.
    星期一早上車站有很多人。
  28. Is there an elevator in this building?
    這棟大樓有電梯嗎？
  29. The shoe department is on the third floor of the department store.
    鞋子賣場在百貨公司的三樓。
  30. Which floor is the music room on? It's on the fourth floor.
    音樂教室在幾樓？在四樓。
  31. December is the twelfth month of the year.
    十二月是一年的第十二個月。
  32. Our hotel room was on the twelfth floor, so the view was great.
    我們的飯店房間在十二樓，所以景色很棒。
  33. Tomorrow is my parents' twentieth wedding anniversary.
    明天是我爸媽結婚二十週年紀念日。
